Definition: from G4506 in the sense of its congener G4482; a flux (of blood):--issue.
BiblicalUsage: The word rhýsis means a flux (of blood). In Luke 8:43, we read, "…woman having an issue of blood twelve years…"; in Mark 5:25, "…certain woman, which had an issue of blood…". And in Luke 8:44, "…garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched" — the same word, doing the same work.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rhýsis matters because God chose this word, and it tells the truth about how God deals with his people. And I believe rhýsis still speaks to us today, because God's word does not go out of date.
